items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: I didn't hear all of the so-called New Orleans greats, but those I did get a chance to hear did not have the talent of King Oliver.

ctx.x: Well, King Oliver himself must have been very inspiring to hear, wasn't he?
Well, he was a marvelous -- King Oliver was the great first jazz trumpet player any of us was to hear.
Those things like Dippermouth and those things -- (unintelligible). He's the one that played them first, isn't he?
